name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. An alternate replacement for scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not a stage alongside them. Requires workspace-init.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a release as a skeleton and drive it from Release 0 through MVP and v1.
interface.longDescription: Ossify plans a release as a skeleton, drives its spine round by round, and closes it with a ceremony that harvests what the round learned. It replaces the scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev pair rather than composing with them — install one lifecycle or the other, not both. It also requires workspace-init: the first entry point refuses fail-fast until a workspace-init pairing manifest exists. On Codex the planning, diagnosis, and close skills work natively; round EXECUTION dispatches an implementer subagent that only the Claude Code surface registers, so drive rounds there.
defaultPrompt: Open a new release with ossify.
Plan the spine for this release.
